blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) warned the public against individuals posing as priests to solicit money for religious services during All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day (Undas). The NCRPO issued the advisory as thousands of families are expected to visit cemeteries, memorial parks and columbaria across Metro Manila for the observance. Read: Manila North, South Cemetery schedules, reminders for Undas 2026 “Undas is a sacred and meaningful occasion for our families to remember and honor our departed loved ones,” said NCRPO Officer-in-Charge Brig.
